content.headline: Your F1 Journey, Together.
content.subheadline: AI-guided. Community-powered. Member-owned. The platform that helps international students navigate the US F1 visa process — transparently, affordably, together. Not just a resource. A cooperative you can own.

content.headline: The F1 Visa Journey is Broken
content.subheadline: International students face three interconnected problems that no single platform solves — until now.

features.title: Complexity & Fear of Denial
features.description: The visa process is opaque and high-stakes. One I-20 or DS-160 error triggers delays. Lawyers cost $300-500/hr. Forums give conflicting advice.

features.title: Isolation
features.description: Students arrive without family or local networks. University international offices are understaffed — 1 advisor per 1,200 students.

features.title: AI Literacy Gap
features.description: The job market demands AI skills, but F-1 students face expensive bootcamps and work restrictions. No structured pathway to build AI readiness.

content.headline: One Platform. Three Solutions.
content.subheadline: F1Visa.Net solves all three problems through a single, integrated platform — built on decentralized, student-owned infrastructure.

features.title: AI-Guided Visa Application
features.description: A dedicated AI agent validates forms, tracks deadlines, and catches errors before submission. Trained specifically on F-1 regulations with real-time policy updates.

features.title: Community-First Architecture
features.description: Live chat, peer forums, and mentor matching. Students don't just use the platform — they own it. 100 Founding Cooperative Members shape our future.

features.title: AI Readiness Pathway
features.description: Tiered membership with a proprietary AI Readiness Assessment. Students build career-ready AI skills while navigating their visa journey.

content.headline: From Discovery to Ownership
content.subheadline: Five stages take you from first ad impression to cooperative ownership. Every step adds value while building trust.

features.title: 1. Discover
features.description: See F1Visa.Net content. Realize: 'Wait, I can OWN the platform that helps me?'

features.title: 2. Explore
features.description: Visit F1Visa.Net. See the cooperative model. 'This looks legit. AI-guided?'

features.title: 3. Experience
features.description: Take the free AI Readiness Assessment. 'This AI actually understands visas.'

features.title: 4. Commit
features.description: Sign up as a Member. Unlock the full AI assistant, mentors, and community.

features.title: 5. Own
features.description: Become a Founding Cooperative Member. Voting rights. Profit-share. Shape the future.

features.title: What's Different?
features.description: Cooperative ownership, not subscriptions. Bilingual EN/ZH. AI literacy credential. Decentralized infrastructure. Student-owned, not VC-funded.

items.question: Is F1visa.Net free?
items.answer: Yes — completely free at point of need. F1visa.Net is a member-owned cooperative. No paywalls, no consultancy fees. The Explorer tier gives you basic AI assistance, forums, and resources at no cost.

items.question: What is cooperative ownership?
items.answer: F1Visa.Net operates as an Onchain Cooperative Association (.OCA). Our 100 Founding Cooperative Members become member-owners — not just customers. They get voting rights on platform direction, profit-share distributions, and a say in what we build next. Learn more at our .OCA page.

items.question: How does the AI assistant work?
items.answer: Our AI is powered by WeOwnLLM — built on AnythingLLM.com and hardened by Minimus.io. It's trained specifically on F-1 visa regulations with real-time policy updates. Unlike generic AI tools, it understands visa forms, SEVIS compliance, and CPT/OPT guidance. It's also bilingual — English and Chinese (Mandarin).

items.question: Who can join the community?
items.answer: Anyone navigating the F1 visa process — whether you're applying from abroad or already studying in the US. Our community at community.F1Visa.Net runs on WordPress with the Fluent Community plugin.

items.question: How is the information verified?
items.answer: Every guide and resource is reviewed by students who have successfully completed the F1 visa process. Community-sourced, peer-reviewed. Our AI assistant is also trained on verified, up-to-date visa regulations.

items.question: Is this a replacement for an immigration lawyer?
items.answer: No. F1visa.Net provides community-sourced guidance and AI-assisted tools for educational purposes. For your specific case, always consult a qualified immigration attorney.

items.question: What are the 100 Founding Cooperative Members?
items.answer: The first 100 members who join as Owners become Founding Cooperative Members — a $99 one-time payment, for life. Founding Members get a tokenized membership certificate, voting rights, profit-share, and exclusive access to events and retreats. Membership (the $9.99/mo or $48/yr tier) is separate and does not include ownership. Learn more at /oca.
